prompt:
Repaint this image in EXACTLY the hand-painted style of a Pillars of Eternity 2: Deadfire pre-rendered isometric background: visible oil-brush strokes, cool stone palette with warm torch-core accents, warm-core/cool-periphery chiaroscuro pooled at the torches, DEEP BLUE-VIOLET cool shadows (never flat black) graded into every corner, a soft atmospheric falloff at the room edges, varied hand-worked texture on every stone plane (no repeated block pattern). SCENE-CONTENT GROUNDING: the low box masses are stacked WOODEN CRATES, BARRELS and burlap SACKS with some masonry RUBBLE; the tall shafts on square bases are structural STONE PILLARS rising to the ceiling; every wall opening shown in the depth is an arched stone DOORWAY; stone flag FLOOR; stone walls with NO windows.

CRITICAL STRUCTURE-LOCK (non-negotiable, checked pixel-by-pixel against the original): every wall, pillar, archway, doorway, staircase, and prop must stay in EXACTLY its current position, size, and shape — do NOT move, add, remove, resize, or recompose ANYTHING; only the paint and lighting treatment changes. Keep the exact same isometric dimetric camera. Do NOT introduce any repeated, cloned, or tiled decorative motifs. Do NOT add any text, letters, numbers, labels, legends, map insets, UI elements, frames, or borders. Do NOT add any characters, people, figures, or creatures. The dark area outside the room walls stays dark empty background — add nothing there, no bones, objects, or debris outside the room. Do NOT add any staircases, steps, balconies, galleries, railings, mezzanines, or upper floors ANYWHERE — this is a strictly SINGLE-STOREY room and every empty corner stays an empty corner (measured defect: invented staircases on 3/3 prior rooms).
